What happened today — 18 Sep 2026

01. Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann announces ₹1 crore for slain cop's family.
02. Mamata Banerjee faction seeks new name after Election Commission freezes party identity
03. Mamata Banerjee Protests After Election Commission Freezes Party Symbol Before By-Polls
04. Election Commission freezes TMC name and symbol ahead of Bengal polls
05. Delhi police arrest four accused including three minors for teen gang rape
06. Army Soldier Dies After Being Locked In Car, Set On Fire In Bihar
07. Andhra government imposed ₹1,000-crore house tax burden on urban residents: CPI(M)
08. Ongole Municipal Corporation eyes World Record with mega waste segregation drive
